process.title: Hello {name}, before we get started.
process.body: You'll need to login, it only requires an email address. Any details we collect will not be kept beyond the event.

form.title: RSVP
form.intro: Everyone is invited to the ceremony and reception, we would like to get a little bit of information from you, this will help us plan food, accomidation and costs.
form.disclamer: Any information we have already or you provide us will only be stored until the event, after which it will deleted.

dietary.label: Dietary requirements.
dietary.info: Please let us know of any dietary concerns we need to pass onto our caterers.

attendance.label: Attendance decision for {name}
attendance.info: Let us know if we can expect you.
attendance.weekend: I would like to attend, the weekend
attendance.weekend-info: Arrive Friday (30th after 3pm), leaving on Sunday (1st Nov, before 11am).
attendance.day: I would like to attend, the day
attendance.day-info: Arrive on Saturday (31st before 11:30am), leaving before midnight.

optional.label: I would like to participate in the childrens treasure hunt game.
optional.info: Weddings can be boring for children, so we've decided to put together a treasure hunt for them. You will be supplied candy and a new clue for when a child finds you.

confirmation.title: Submitted on {date}
confirmation.not: {name} has indicated they are not coming

about.title: What's happening?
about.intro: Yes it's finally happening, Heather and Adam are getting married, 16 years in the making.
about.content: We are planning a weekend away event in Kent (England), and look forward to be joined by friends and family (including kids) to help us celebrate, we will accommodate who we can onsite.

bullet.when: When? 31st October 2026 The ceremony will start at midday. If you're coming on the day please arrive by 11:30am, so you have time to get seated and comfortable.
bullet.where: Where? Bore Place, Bore Place Road, Chiddingstone, Edenbridge, Kent, TN8 7AR you can find detailed directions here
bullet.what: What's the dress code? Although this is on Halloween, this is not a costume party. Please dress formally. The bridal party will be dressed in autumnal colours, but feel free to dress in any colours you like (except white). Weather permitting we hope to hold the ceremony outdoors and on grass, so sensible shoes are advisable.

food_drink.title: Food and drink
food_drink.content: Here you can find all the information we have about food and drink. Our caterers will work hard to ensure all dietary requirements are correctly handled, so please keep us informed.

friday.title: Friday
friday.body0: If you are arriving on the Friday we are currently coordinating evening food, We will update this space when we know final numbers.
friday.body1: We won't be providing alcoholic beverages, so please bring your own.

other.title: Everything else
other.body0: For those staying on site, a continental breakfast will be supplied by Bore Place, including vegan and gluten free options.
other.body1: If there is something specific you need or want, you're welcome to bring it with you.
other.body2: Tea and coffee will be available in kitchens at anytime.

day.title: Reception
day.body0: The wedding breakfast, canapés and dancing food will be supplied by our amazing caterer Home Gurr'own.
day.body1: During canapés, packed lunches will be provided for children.
day.body2: We will provide you with bubbles, beer, wine and non-alcoholic options. However if there is a specific drink, you'd like to consume, you're welcome to bring it with you.

out.subtitle: <mobile>"Follow me, to where the party people are"</mobile><mobile> - </mobile>That Bulgarian Guy
out.title: Music
out.description: Sorry, You will need to log in to suggest songs.

contact.title: Contact Information
contact.body: If you are unsure about anything, or need to contact us about a wedding related thing and strangely don't have our details;
contact.end: <mobile>Website made by Adam, </mobile>Lovingly edited Jane & Heather.

intro.title: Frequently Asked Questions.
intro.subtext: If you can't find an answer here to a question you have; please just message us directly.

deadline.question: When is the RSVP deadline?
deadline.answer: 2nd of August 2026. To help us coordinate everything, it would be appreciated if we can get responses early. Or we will be chasing you!

plan.question: What is the plan?
plan.answer: We have hired a venue from Friday night to Sunday morning, we hope to accomodate as many as possible. The ceremony will be held on the Saturday at the Hide (outside) with wedding breakfast and reception in the Large Barn. Everything is on-site and within walking distance.

location.question: How do I get to the venue?
location.answer: Detailed directions can be found here. There is plenty of parking available for those who drive. For those coming from abroad, Gatwick is the closest airport.

dress.question: What is the dress code?
dress.answer: It is a formal dress event, if you need inspiration we are suggesting autumnal colours as it's our theme. Weather permitting we hope to hold the ceremony outdoors and on grass so sensible shoes and something warm is advised.

weather.question: What about the weather?
weather.answer: Autumn in the UK can be cold and rainy. So keep everything crossed for good weather. We will fall back to an indoor location if we have to, but we are a hardy outdoors bunch and will supply umbrellas.

plusOne.question: Can I bring plus one?
plusOne.answer: We have limited space so can only really accomodate named guests, unless we let you know otherwise.

food.question: Do I need to bring food or drink?
food.answer: We've got most of it covered. Read more here.

gift.question: Is there a gift registry?
gift.answer: No! and please don't bring gifts or money to the venue. We have been together for 16 years we have everything we need, including multiple bottle openers. Your presence is the only gift we're after! But if you insist, bank details can be found here.

accomodation.question: What is the cost of accomodation?
accomodation.answer: Although we would love to pay for everyone, it would be appreciated if guests help us cover a little of the cost. More information here.

environment.question: What do I need to be aware of?
environment.answer: As the venue is also a working farm, some areas are out of bounds. Please note that paper confetti is not allowed and no open candles / flames.

directions.preTitle: How to get to Bore Place
directions.title: Directions
directions.subTitle: Please be aware phone signal can be poor around Chiddingstone. We advise downloading maps in advance and ensure you have cash if taking a taxi.

driving.title: Driving
driving.body0: Bore Place is in Kent, just south of Sevenoaks. For those unfamiliar with the UK it's south of London.
driving.body1: Directions are covered well on their <a1>website</a1>, we would suggest checking <a2>Google maps</a2> or use a good GPS.

flying.title: Flying In
flying.body0: London Gatwick is the closest airport, City is a good alternative, both are an hours travel away.
flying.body1: Getting from the airport to the venue, the easiest route is via train, Gatwick > London Bridge > Sevenoaks, then grab a taxi.

adventurous.title: Adventurous People
adventurous.body0: There is a train station in Penshurst, about 4.2km (2.6 miles) from the venue, you can walk across the lovely British countryside.
adventurous.body1: We did this, it was fun but we did get a little lost. As a side note the pub The Little Brown Jug is lovely!
adventurous.body2: Please follow the <a1>countryside code</a1>, be prepared and safe. <a2>Here is a route</a2> we attempted, we hold no responsibiity for suggesting this.

public.title: Public Transport
public.body0: Sevenoaks train station is the more convenient, well connected station.
public.body1: It has a taxi rank outside, which you will need to get the 9.7km (6 miles) to the venue. It should take around 19 minutes, it costs a little over 20 pounds.
public.body2: If you have trouble or wish to pre-book, Beeline is a recommended / local company.
